On July 7, 2023, the Cudahy Rent Stabilization Ordinance ("RSO") went into effect, establishing Cudahy Municipal Code, Chapter 5.13. The RSO, among other things, established an annual rental unit registration ("Rental Registry") requiring information to be collected on all rental units that are rented or available for rent for a term exceeding 30 consecutive days. All landlords, including mobile home parks owners, are responsible for registering every residential Rental Unit, unless exempt from the RSO pursuant to CMC Section 5.13.040. Landlords must complete the registration by July 1st of each year
